proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13119 sadṛkṣa like explicitly supplies Prakrit sarikkha/sārikkha, Punjabi sarkhā, Hindi sarikā/sarīkhā, Old Marwari sārikho and Gujarati sarkhũ. Selected western sarka/harka responses match this comparative family, with s/h realization, aspiration variation and final vowels retained as qualifications. The same gloss denotes likeness/equivalence; local Indo-Aryan transmission is unresolved. Exact response: sarke.
